text: A股通信设备板块今日开盘下跌，随后跌幅集体收窄。有市场消息称，美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）正在起草一项禁令，旨在禁止美国进口中国数据中心组件新机型，包括光模块。当日，记者以投资者身份分别致电中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信董秘办。中际旭创董秘办工作人员称，公司已注意到相关市场信息，经核实，美国联邦通信委员会尚未出台相关领域限制性文件。该负责人称，“因为美国联邦通信委员会并未出台相关领域限制性文件，公司对相关传闻不予评述。”
text_en: A-share communications equipment stocks opened lower today but narrowed losses collectively. Market chatter said the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is drafting a ban aimed at prohibiting US imports of new models of Chinese data center components, including optical modules. On the day, reporters contacted the board secretary offices of Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink, and Tianfu Communication as investors. Zhongji Innolight's board secretary staff said the company had noted the market information and, after verification, the FCC had not yet issued restrictive documents in the relevant field. The official said, 'Because the FCC has not issued restrictive documents in the relevant field, the company will not comment on the rumors.'
